about_pullquote: I fix things properly because I know my customers trust me to keep their homes safe.
about_para_1: Matt set up his electrical and handyman business in Nottingham over a decade ago after realising how hard it was to find someone honest and reliable. What started as evening work quickly became full-time, and today he's completed over 500 residential jobs across the city. He's trained to current Building Regulations, fully insured, and genuinely cares about getting the work right first time.
about_para_2: Customers come back because Matt turns up on time, explains what he's doing, and leaves no mess. He's not interested in upselling; if a simple fix will do the job, that's what you'll get. His reputation speaks for itself — word-of-mouth referrals now make up most of his work, and he's become a familiar face in Nottingham's family homes and small businesses.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Matt

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a loose light switch that wouldn't turn off properly. Matt came out same afternoon, sorted it in minutes, and charged me fairly. No faffing about, no overcharging — exactly what you want. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Called Matt about a tripped electrics issue on Boxing Day. Didn't expect anyone to answer, but he came out within the hour. Really professional, found the fault straight away, and fixed it. Top bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Matt installed new spotlights in our kitchen and added USB sockets everywhere. Wiring is hidden, looks brilliant, and he cleaned up after himself. Great job, competitive price, and he knew exactly what he was doing. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.
